g.text: Background jobs on dev: one ledger, one listener, outcomes as files (proposal, 2026-11-15)
runs on the host today (per the Source line of this diagram)
not deployed; part of the proposal
the element this figure is about
communication path; arrow points from the side that opens the connection
artifacts deployed to that node (UML textual notation)
The only new workload is the ocr pod; it uses the paths lcpencrypt and the extraction workers already use.
Every worker sends task events (-E; the catalog's own through CELERY_WORKER_SEND_TASK_EVENTS),
so the listener in evilflowers-beat sees every task of every worker and records it as a run of its job.
The portal never talks to Redis or a worker: it declares jobs at /api/v1/jobs (apply, patch);
the reconciler sends runs, and revokes a cancelled job's run (pidbox, same Redis).
